Take a shelter dog out for the day in New York

Want to rent or borrow a dog in New York? These shelters let you take an adoptable dog on a day trip, hike or sleepover for free. 9 shelter programs in New York, 6 of them open to the public. Cities include Briarcliff Manor, Fairport, Liverpool, New York, Ridgewood, Staten Island, Victor, West Seneca.

ShelterDayOut is a free directory. We don't run outings or handle bookings; each shelter sets its own rules. Listings are checked monthly, but details change, so confirm with the shelter before you go.

Ready to adopt? ShelterAdoption, our sister site, lists every shelter near you plus upcoming adoption events.
